name: Application Observability & Telemetry
description: Application-level observability and code instrumentation. IMPORTANT DISTINCTION: This skill covers observability from a 'software developer instrumenting code' perspective — writing structured JSON logs with correlation IDs, defining custom Prometheus counters/histograms in HTTP handlers, injecting OpenTelemetry trace spans across distributed calls, integrating APM agents to profile database query bottlenecks, and setting up readiness/liveness health check endpoints. This is fundamentally different from the DevOps role's monitoring_observability skill, which approaches the same domain from an infrastructure operations perspective (installing Prometheus/Grafana clusters, configuring Kubernetes DaemonSets, managing VM log shippers, and provisioning alertmanager hardware). Here the backend engineer asks 'how do I instrument my code to emit meaningful spans and metrics?'; in DevOps the engineer asks 'how do I host and scale the monitoring infrastructure?'.

subskills.name: Structured JSON Logging
subskills.description: Structured JSON logging (Winston, Zap, Logback, structlog), log levels, correlation IDs, contextual metadata (userId, tenantId), and avoiding logging sensitive PII.

subskills.name: Application Metrics (Prometheus)
subskills.description: Prometheus metric types (Counter, Gauge, Histogram, Summary), defining custom business metrics in code, label cardinality limits, and /metrics scraping endpoints.

subskills.name: Health Checks & Probes
subskills.description: Implementing /healthz, /readyz, and /startup endpoints, verifying downstream database and message broker connectivity, and graceful shutdown handling.

subskills.name: Distributed Tracing (OpenTelemetry)
subskills.description: OpenTelemetry (OTel) SDK instrumentation, traceId and spanId creation, W3C TraceContext HTTP header propagation (traceparent), and span attributes.

subskills.name: APM & Code Profiling Integration
subskills.description: Application Performance Monitoring (APM) agents (Datadog, New Relic, Elastic APM), automatic database query instrumentation, and slow query identification.

subskills.name: Error Tracking & Sentry SDK
subskills.description: Automated error capture using Sentry / Rollbar SDKs, capturing stack traces and request context, fingerprinting errors, and alert noise reduction.

subskills.name: SLI/SLO Application Telemetry
subskills.description: Defining Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) directly from application telemetry (availability ratio, latency percentiles).

subskills.name: Continuous Code Profiling
subskills.description: Production CPU and memory profiling (Pyroscope, Go pprof, async-profiler), analyzing Flamegraphs, and identifying memory allocation hotspots.

subskills.name: Telemetry Correlation & RCA
subskills.description: Correlating distributed trace spans with structured logs (log-to-trace linking) and metric anomalies for rapid Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
